item.text: {"analysis":"Trial crashed after 14.08 allocated GPU-seconds and produced no validation score. The supplied traceback only reports the training subprocess's nonzero exit; the underlying exception and failure stage remain unknown. Numerical-tolerance checks and exception logging were included, but their effectiveness cannot be confirmed without the training output or training_error.txt. No HR@10 result or performance improvement is established.","code_summary":"One independently trained GRURec model per category, with all four dataset routes retained. Each network uses 96-dimensional item embeddings, a two-layer GRU, and a causal masked prefix-mean branch fused through a linear layer initialized to preserve the GRU output. Normalized features and item embeddings produce cosine scores with learned scale and item bias. Training uses eight sampled negatives, softplus loss, AdamW, mixed precision, gradient clipping, and validation-based selection of one checkpoint per category. The predictor loads the matching architecture and exactly one checkpoint per category; no ensemble or checkpoint averaging is used."}
